en: The image is a black-and-white photograph featuring a small body of water (possibly a pond or canal) in the foreground, with residential houses and apartment blocks in the background. The houses are typical European rowhouses, and in the distance, there is a church tower with a spire rising above the rooftops. The scene is tranquil and suburban, with some landscaped greenery near the water and TV antennas visible on many rooftops.
